statement: MSTGAM with monthly decisions earns a positive excess over its exposure-matched cash/buy-and-hold blend
statistic: mean over instrument x test-year cells (seeds averaged) of annualized excess over the blend; one-sided t over the yearly cross-instrument means, df = years - 1
secondary: median cell, sign count and leave-one-instrument-out t are reported, not decisive
origin: 2019-2025 research runs: +5.3%/yr, t 2.8, concentrated in GRPN and GM

statement: Ring's selected training excess information ratio predicts its test-year excess over the blend
statistic: Spearman correlation over instrument x test-year cells (seeds averaged) between the selected chromosome's training excess IR and its test-year annualized excess; one-sided
origin: 2019-2025 research run: rho 0.19 over fold-seed fits, p 0.03
